primary_interest.quote: We want a voice AI support agent that answers patient and provider calls

use_case.quote: We want a voice AI support agent that answers patient and provider calls: scheduling questions, billing questions, status on referrals

inference_framing.quote: I don't want inference as a standalone thing. I only care about it as the part that makes the agent work.

inference_raised_by.quote: Which, actually, that's the piece I want to dig into. The model behind the agent is what makes or breaks it for us.

competitors_inference.quote: We've compared OpenAI direct and Baseten.

decision_criteria.quote: Baseten quoted us about forty-two cents per million tokens. Your team's quote came back around a dollar nine per million.

stated_reason.quote: We have EU patients, so the data has to stay in the EU, and we'd need a DPA signed. That's a gate for us, not a nice-to-have.
